scripts.source:check: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.sf/convert-check',{recursive:true,force:true})" && SF_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true npx -y @salesforce/cli@2.159.7 project convert source --root-dir force-app --output-dir .sf/convert-check
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint:styles && npm run apex:check && npm run source:check
scripts.org:validate: SF_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true npx -y @salesforce/cli@2.159.7 project deploy validate --source-dir force-app --test-level RunLocalTests
scripts.org:deploy: SF_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true npx -y @salesforce/cli@2.159.7 project deploy start --source-dir force-app --test-level RunLocalTests
scripts.org:test: SF_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true npx -y @salesforce/cli@2.159.7 apex run test --test-level RunLocalTests --code-coverage --result-format human --wait 10
